import os,glob,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def comps(g,val=None):
    g=np.array(g)
    bg=g[0][0]; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool)
    out=[]
    for i in range(g.shape[0]):
        for j in range(g.shape[1]):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y,x]: continue
                    seen[y,x]=True; c.append((y,x)); v=g[y,x]
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<g.shape[0] and 0<=nx<g.shape[1] and g[ny,nx]==v and not seen[ny,nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((v,c))
    return out

def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    comps=comps(g)
    markers={(v,c) for v,c in comps if len(c)==1}
    struct=[(v,c) for v,c in comps if len(c)>1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # markers -> 4
    mk=set(markers)
    def hit(i,j):
        if (g[i][j],[(i,j)]) in mk or any((i,j)==p for _,cs in mk for p in cs): return True
        return False
    for (v,cells) in markers:
        for (y,x) in cells: out[y][x]=4
    # structural rays: from each cell of comp, emit along direction away from nearest edge...
    # determine dominant axis & sign: use centroid; ray direction = away from the edge the component touches
    for v,cells in struct:
        ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        cy,cx=(min(ys)+max(ys))/2,(min(xs)+max(xs))/2
        diry = 1 if min(ys)>=1 else -1
        dirx = 1 if min(xs)>=1 else -1
        # actually for vertical bar touching top edge: ray down (+y); bottom edge: ray up (-y)
        # for col0 bar: ray right (+x); col(W-1): ray left (-x)
        sy=sx=0
        if min(ys)==0 and max(ys)<H-1: sy=1
        elif max(ys)==H-1: sy=-1
        elif max(ys)==H-1: sy=-1
        else: pass
        if min(xs)==0 and max(xs)<W-1: sx=1
        elif min(xs)==W-1: sx=-1
        elif max(xs)==W-1: sx=-1
        else: pass
        for (y,x) in cells:
            yy,x=x+sy,sx+sx
            while 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy][xx]==bg:
                out[yy][xx]=v; yy+=sy; xx+=sx
                if (yy,xx) in [(my,mx) for (_,cs) in mk for my,mx in cs]:
                    out[yy][xx]=4; break
    return out

def solve(grid):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    cs=comps(g)
    marks={tuple(p) for v,p in cs if len(p)==1}
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for v,c in cs:
        ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
        if len(set(xs))==1: sy=-1; sx=1 if min(xs)>0 else -1 if max(xs)==W-1 else 0
        elif len(set(ys))==1: sy=0; sx=-1
        else:
            cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))/2; cx=(min(xs)+max(xs))/2
            sy=1 if cy>H/2 else -1
            sx=1 if cx<W/2 else -1
        for (y,x) in c:
            yy,xx=y+sy,x+sx
            while 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W:
                if g[yy][xx]!=bg: break
                o[yy][xx]=v
                if (yy,xx) in marks: o[yy][xx]=4; break
                yy+=sy; xx+=sx
    return o

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    marks=[]; walls=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==bg: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; c=[]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                if seen[y][x]: continue
                seen[y][x]=True; c.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==v and not seen[ny][nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
            if len(c)==1: marks.append((c[0],v)); 
            elif len(c)>=2: walls.append((c,v))

def solve(g):

    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # candidate colors
    cand=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    def touches(v):
        return any(g[r][c]==v and (r==0 or r==H-1 or c==0 or c==W-1) for r in range(H) for c in range(W))
    ac=[v for v in cand if touches(v)][0]
    # spans per side
    def runspan(cells):
        s=sorted(set(cells)); out=[];cur=None
        for x in s:
            if cur is None or x>cur+1:
                if cur is not None: out.append(cur)
                cur=x
            else: cur=x
        if cur is not None: out.append(cur)
        return out
    spans={'L':runspan([r for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in (0,W-1) if g[r][c]==ac and c==0]],1),
           'R':runspan([r for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in (0,W-1) if g[r][c]==ac and c==W-1]],1),
           'T':runspan([c for r,c in [(r,c) for r in (0,H-1) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==ac and r==0]],1),
           'B':runspan([c for r,c in [(r,c) for r in (0,H-1) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==ac and r==H-1]],1)}
    # only real edges matter; drop empty
    spans={k:v for k,v in spans.items() if v}
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=ac]
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for sr,sc in seeds:

        # which side's span contains seed along its axis

            s=S=set(s)
            if side in ('L','R') and sc in S: side=side
            if side=='T' and sr in set(spans['T']): side=side
            if side=='B' and sr in set(spans['B']): side=side
        if side is None: continue
        other={'L':'R','R':'L','T':'B','B':'T'}[side]
        Ss=spans[side]; Os=spans[other]
        # offset within side's span along its own axis
        if side in ('L','R'):
            o=sc-Ss[0]
            dst_row=min(Os)+o
        else:
            o=sr-Ss[0]
            dst_row=min(Os)+o
        colcolor=g[sr][sc]
        for c in range(W): res[dst_row][c]=colcolor
        # fill between seed and own-side anchor column (exclusive of anchor edge)
        if side=='L':
            for c in range(sc+1,W-1): res[sr][c]=colcolor
        elif side=='R':
            for c in range(W-1,sc,-1): res[sr][c]=colcolor
        elif side=='T':
            for r in range(sr+1,H-1): res[r][sc]=colcolor
        else:
            for r in range(H-1,sr,-1): res[r][sc]=colcolor
    return res

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

print('changes:', six)
# group painted columns

print('painted cols sorted by column: rows', {c:[r for r,_ in six if __==c and False]})

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mc=[c for c,_ in cnt.items() if c!=bg][1:]
    mark=max(mc,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); seed=min(mc,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    # strips
    def runs(cells, keys):
        out=[]
        cur=None
        for k,v in sorted(cells):
            if cur is None: cur=(k,v); continue
            if keys[v]==keys[cur[0]] and cur[1]+1==v:
                cur=(cur[0],v)
            else:
                out.append((cur[0],cur[1])); cur=(k,v)
        if cur: out.append(cur)
        return out
    marks={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==mark}
    # vertical if column-max-run >= row-max-run
    best_v=0;best_h=0
    for c in range(W):
        col=[r for r,c_ in marks if c_==c]
        best_v=max(best_v, max([end-start+1 for st,end_ in groupby_runs(col)], default=0))
    for r in range(H):
        row=[c for r_,c in marks if r_==r]
        best_h=max(best_h, max([end-start+1 for st,end_ in groupby_runs(row)], default=0))
    vert = best_v>=best_h
    if vert:
        spans={}
        for c,rs in [groupby_runs([r for r,_ in marks])] :
            pass

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    mark=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); seed=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    res=[list(r_)[:] for r_ in g]
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==mark]
    # bar groups
    groups={}
    for r,c in marks: groups.setdefault(c,[r]) if False else None
    # decide orientation
    if len({c for r,c in marks})>=2: axis='V'
    else: axis='H'
    gdict={}
    for r,c in marks:
        key=c if axis=='V' else r
        gdict.setdefault(key,{})
        gdict[key][(r if axis=='V' else c)] = True
    bars=[]
    for k,vv in sorted(gdict.items()):
        sv=sorted(vv)
        bars.append({'axis':axis,'col':k,'rows':(sv[0],sv[-1])})
    seeds=[(r,c) for r,c in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[rr][cc]==seed]]
    for sr,sc in seeds:
        res[sr][sc]=4
        cand=[B for B in bars if B['axis']=='V'] if axis=='V' else [B for B in bars if B['axis']=='H']
        def dist(B,s):
            return abs(s - (B['rows'][0] if B['axis']=='V' else B['rows'][1]))
        home=min(cand,key=lambda B:(dist(B,(sc if axis=='V' else sr)) if False else (dist(B,sc) if axis=='V' else dist(B,sr))))
        far=[B for B in bars if B is not home][0]
        # ray toward far bar
        if axis=='V':
            d=1 if sc<far['col'] else -1
            p=sc+d
            while 0<=p<W and res[sr][p]==bg:
                res[sr][p]=seed; p+=d
        else:
            d=1 if sr<far['rows'][0] else -1
            p=sr+d
            while 0<=p<H and res[p][sc]==bg:
                res[p][sc]=seed; p+=d
        # mapped row/col
        off=(sr-home['rows'][0]) if axis=='V' else (sc-home['rows'][0])
        tgt=far['rows'][0]+off
        lo,hi=far['rows']
        if axis=='V' and (tgt<lo or tgt>hi):
            # copy shifted by bar width+1, continue until inside span
            sgn=-1
            while True:
                tgt=tgt+sgn*(len(home['rows'])+1)
                if lo<=tgt<=hi: break
        if axis=='V' and lo<=tgt<=hi:
            for cc in range(W):
                if res[tgt][cc]==bg: res[tgt][cc]=seed
        else:
            pass
    return res
for k in [6,7,8]:
    print(k, solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
